newsitem.title: ITALY: Stet wants AT&T link by year-end.
newsitem.headline: Stet wants AT&T link by year-end.

text.p: Italian state telecommunications giant Stet is aiming for an alliance with AT&T Corp by the year end, Stet managing director Tomaso Tommasi di Vignano said on Wednesday.
Asked when an accord with AT&T would happen, Tommasi di Vignano replied: "We are working intensely on this and the objective is to have an accord on an international alliance by the year end."
Tommasi, talking to reporters at a meeting of industry confederation Confindustria, confirmed he was referring to AT&T.
